item.title: How to use Winston logger in Node.js
item.description: Winston provides enterprise-grade logging for Node.js applications with multiple transports, custom formatting, and flexible log level management. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented Winston logging in Node.js production services. The most effective approach is configuring Winston with console and file transports for comprehensive logging. This method enables simultaneous logging to multiple destinations with different formats and levels.
